note: These observations are grounded in official Fomo product documentation/public pages. Geometry/timing measurements are intentionally left null until captured by the harvester or equivalent browser instrumentation.

observations.observation: Fomo Web uses the same account, profile, balance, positions, following graph and notification settings as mobile; trades opened on one device appear on the other.
observations.whyItWorks: The product feels like one persistent identity rather than separate mobile and desktop products.
observations.gasTranslation: GAS account, profile, balances, preferences, Crews/follows and pending activity must be device-independent.
observations.gasImprovement: Extend continuity beyond trading into active/pending game-round recovery and rebase/reserve notifications.

observations.observation: Fomo documents cross-chain swaps from one unified USD balance without normal chain switching or bridging.
observations.whyItWorks: It removes infrastructure decisions from the consumer task.
observations.gasTranslation: Normal GAS flows should not require RPC/network/bridge knowledge where architecture can safely abstract it.
observations.gasImprovement: GAS must preserve economic truth: unified presentation cannot flatten cash, GAS, pending wagers, reserve backing or future Bracket positions into the same spendable balance.

observations.observation: Fomo redesigned its social feed to improve scanability and organization during high-activity periods.
observations.whyItWorks: Social/market feeds fail when every row demands equal cognitive attention.
observations.gasTranslation: GAS live/social feed needs a compact hierarchy for routine events and stronger treatment for high-signal game/trade/rebase/Crew events.
observations.gasImprovement: Use explicit event authority/state and collapse low-signal repeated activity rather than merely increasing feed density.

observations.observation: Trade theses can appear in the global feed with trader PnL and balance context and can be liked/interacted with directly.
observations.whyItWorks: The social claim carries performance context at the point of discovery.
observations.gasTranslation: Game/trade result cards should carry verified GAS context and a direct path to inspect the player/round/configuration.
observations.gasImprovement: Anchor result claims to canonical round/transaction IDs and distinguish verified protocol facts from user commentary.

observations.observation: Fomo added a focused friends/following feed distinct from the global feed.
observations.whyItWorks: Users can switch between broad discovery and high-relevance personal signals.
observations.gasTranslation: GAS should support global network discovery plus a following/Crew-focused feed without fragmenting identity.
observations.gasImprovement: Crews can add a third contextual lens while keeping one canonical event stream underneath.

observations.observation: Leaderboards rank traders over multiple timeframes; users can open profiles, inspect portfolio/current positions/cash/recent trades, and follow traders.
observations.whyItWorks: Ranking is not a dead-end trophy page; it is a discovery funnel into identity and activity.
observations.gasTranslation: Existing GAS leaderboard bones should become player/Crew discovery that leads into profile/activity and follow actions.
observations.gasImprovement: Avoid pure-volume ranking; expose rank methodology and favor verified skill/activity metrics resistant to trivial wagering-volume gaming.

observations.observation: Fomo documents a five-destination bottom-navigation model: home, search, social feed, friends/leaderboard, profile.
observations.whyItWorks: Persistent mobile destinations keep the product learnable while social/discovery/account remain one thumb away.
observations.gasTranslation: Phase 6 should test a five-destination GAS mobile shell, likely Home/Play/Trade/Crews/Account with search contextual or universal.
observations.gasImprovement: Make Play the dominant center action and keep Reserve trust accessible without consuming a scarce bottom-nav slot unless evidence supports it.

observations.observation: Fomo search spans both assets and user profiles.
observations.whyItWorks: One discovery primitive crosses financial and social entities.
observations.gasTranslation: GAS universal search should eventually find players, Crews, games, transactions and Bracket markets.
observations.gasImprovement: Return contextual actions in results instead of forcing users through an intermediate generic detail page.

observations.observation: Personal profiles include volume, followers/following, portfolio performance and detailed activity; cash balance is an entry point to withdrawal.
observations.whyItWorks: Identity, performance and account actions are colocated.
observations.gasTranslation: GAS profiles should combine social identity, verified activity, performance/game history and relationship context while account/withdraw actions remain obvious for the owner.
observations.gasImprovement: Separate public profile information from private account/balance data with explicit visibility rules.

observations.observation: Fomo notifications can surface top/followed trader activity, market activity, announcements and new followers.
observations.whyItWorks: The product extends beyond active sessions and brings users back to high-signal context.
observations.gasTranslation: GAS notifications should be event-specific: settled result, followed player, Crew milestone, rebase, deposit/withdrawal and future Bracket position event.
observations.gasImprovement: Deep-link to the exact canonical state and apply user-controlled signal thresholds to avoid casino-style spam.

observations.observation: Fomo integrates TradingView charts and optional indicators/drawing tools while retaining its social/execution shell; social activity can overlay charts.
observations.whyItWorks: Power-user depth is added contextually rather than replacing the simple default path.
observations.gasTranslation: GAS can later offer advanced trade/Bracket analytics behind progressive disclosure without making Home/Play a terminal.
observations.gasImprovement: Use one shared GAS event/social model so advanced views do not fork social context from the simple experience.

observations.observation: Fomo perpetuals reuse feed, leaderboard, thesis, profiles and notifications instead of introducing a separate social system.
observations.whyItWorks: New financial products inherit network effects and user identity immediately.
observations.gasTranslation: Bracket should later inherit GAS identity/profile/feed/notifications instead of becoming a separate UX silo.
observations.gasImprovement: GAS can additionally preserve explicit financial-domain labels so social continuity does not imply shared solvency/collateral.

observations.observation: Fomo documents account creation by email or Apple ID and funding through crypto/debit card/Apple Pay.
observations.whyItWorks: The user begins with familiar consumer identity/funding primitives rather than wallet setup terminology.
observations.gasTranslation: GAS account onboarding should lead with familiar sign-in/funding methods while still supporting self-custody paths where appropriate.
observations.gasImprovement: Make bounded play permissions and withdrawal/recovery semantics explicit in human language rather than hiding custody/account tradeoffs.

observations.observation: Fomo publicly emphasizes easy onboarding, multichain/gasless abstraction, one-click buy, feed, leaderboard and alerts as the core consumer benefits.
observations.whyItWorks: The product markets outcomes and behaviors rather than protocol infrastructure.
observations.gasTranslation: GAS Home/marketing should lead with GAS/Play/network/social trust outcomes, not share-index/oracle/AMM implementation details.
observations.gasImprovement: Use reserve/rebase transparency as trust proof one layer deeper while still surfacing essential backing/rebase state at a glance.
